import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNActivation(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
        super().__init__(*layers)


class Inception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch_a = ConvBNActivation(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = ConvBNActivation(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = ConvBNActivation(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch_b_3 = ConvBNActivation(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=5)
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = ConvBNActivation(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        b1 = self.branch_a(x)
        y2 = self.branch_b_1(x)
        y2 = self.branch_b_2(y2)
        y2 = self.branch_b_3(y2)
        bp = self.pool(x)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([b1, y2, bp], dim=1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)

class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                self.depthwise_conv(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            self.depthwise_conv(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def depthwise_conv(i, o, kernel_size, stride=1, padding=0, bias=False) -> nn.Conv2d:
        return nn.Conv2d(i, o, kernel_size, stride, padding, bias=bias, groups=i)

        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class FeedForward(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert hidden_dim % num_heads == 0, "hidden_dim must be divisible by num_heads"
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        torch._assert(tensor.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {tensor.shape}")
        h = self.ln_1(tensor)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + tensor

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(BasicConv2d, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        if not self.use_act:
            return x
        return F.relu(x)


class MobileBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio):
        super(MobileBlock, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + x
        return out

from torch import Tensor


class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)

        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.squeeze_activation(self.sq(x))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.ex1(x)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.ex3(x))], 1
        )

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.norm3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        identity = tensor

        out = self.conv1(tensor)
        out = self.norm1(out)
        out = F.hardswish(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.norm2(out)
        out = F.hardswish(out)
        out = self.conv3(out)
        out = self.norm3(out)

        if self.proj is not None:
            identity = self.proj(tensor)

        out += identity
        out = F.hardswish(out)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super(ConvBN, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.relu(z, inplace=True)


class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super(SEBlock, self).__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Hardsigmoid()

    def forward(self, z):
        scale = self.avgpool(z)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * z


class MobileBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super(MobileBlock, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvBN(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBN(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, padding=2, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SEBlock(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z):
        out = self.conv(z)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + z
        return out

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = z.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(z), self.branch2(z)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNReLU(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.ReLU6()

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.conv(feats)
        feats = self.bn(feats)
        if self.use_act:
            feats = self.act(feats)
        return feats


class MixedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features, conv_block=None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvBNReLU
        self.branch1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = conv_block(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch3_3 = conv_block(ch3 * 2, ch3, kernel_size=(7, 1))
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, feats):
        b1 = self.branch1(feats)
        br2 = self.branch2_1(feats)
        br2 = self.branch2_2(br2)
        b3 = self.branch3_1(feats)
        b3 = self.branch3_2(b3)
        b3 = self.branch3_3(b3)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(feats, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [b1, br2, b3, bp]

    def forward(self, feats):
        outputs = self._forward(feats)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_a = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.bn_b = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        shortcut_out = input

        h = self.conv1(input)
        h = self.bn_a(h)
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.conv2(h)
        h = self.bn_b(h)

        if self.proj is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.proj(input)

        h = h + shortcut_out
        h = F.relu(h, inplace=True)
        return h

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super(BottleneckBlock, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        identity = z

        h = self.conv1(z)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = F.silu(h, inplace=True)
        h = self.conv2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)
        h = F.silu(h, inplace=True)
        h = self.conv3(h)
        h = self.bn3(h)

        if self.skip is not None:
            identity = self.skip(z)

        h = h + identity
        h = F.silu(h, inplace=True)
        return h

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        h, _ = self.self_attention(x, x, x, need_weights=False)
        h = self.ln_1(self.dropout(h) + x)
        y = self.mlp(h)
        return self.ln_2(h + y)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(x)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseStage(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = [x]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(outputs, 1))
            outputs.append(new)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = conv1x1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn_a = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_b = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv3 = conv1x1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn_c = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.relu3 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        residual = x

        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn_a(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn_b(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.conv3(out)
        out = self.bn_c(out)

        if self.skip is not None:
            residual = self.skip(x)

        out = out + residual
        out = self.relu3(out)
        return out

def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = make_conv3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.relu = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut_out = x

        y = self.c1(x)
        y = self.norm1(y)
        y = self.relu(y)
        y = self.c2(y)
        y = self.norm2(y)

        if self.proj is not None:
            shortcut_out = self.proj(x)

        y += shortcut_out
        y = self.relu(y)
        return y

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super(BasicConv2d, self).__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride,
                              padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        input = self.conv(input)
        input = self.bn(input)
        if self.use_act:
            input = self.act(input)
        return input


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, ch4):
        super(InceptionBlock, self).__init__()
        self.branch_a = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch_c_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2a = BasicConv2d(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch_c_2b = BasicConv2d(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch_d_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch4, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_d_2 = BasicConv2d(ch4, ch4, kernel_size=(7, 1))

    def _forward(self, input: Tensor):
        b1 = self.branch_a(input)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(input)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        b3 = self.branch_c_1(input)
        b3 = [
            self.branch_c_2a(b3),
            self.branch_c_2b(b3),
        ]
        b3 = torch.cat(b3, 1)
        b4 = self.branch_d_1(input)
        b4 = self.branch_d_2(b4)
        return [b1, b2, b3, b4]

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(input)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return F.relu6(x)


class InceptionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch_a = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2a = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch_b_2b = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.branch_c_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2 = BasicConv2d(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_c_3 = BasicConv2d(ch3 * 2, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 7), padding=(0, 3))
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv2d(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        br1 = self.branch_a(x)
        br2 = self.branch_b_1(x)
        br2 = [
            self.branch_b_2a(br2),
            self.branch_b_2b(br2),
        ]
        br2 = torch.cat(br2, 1)
        y3 = self.branch_c_1(x)
        y3 = self.branch_c_2(y3)
        y3 = self.branch_c_3(y3)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(x, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([br1, br2, y3, bp], dim=1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBNAct(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        ]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.Hardswish())
        super().__init__(*layers)


class MultiBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = ConvBNAct(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = ConvBNAct(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = ConvBNAct(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch3_3a = ConvBNAct(ch3 * 2, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch3_3b = ConvBNAct(ch3 * 2, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch_pool = ConvBNAct(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, feats: Tensor):
        br1 = self.branch1(feats)
        b2 = self.branch2_1(feats)
        b2 = self.branch2_2(b2)
        b3 = self.branch3_1(feats)
        b3 = self.branch3_2(b3)
        b3 = [
            self.branch3_3a(b3),
            self.branch3_3b(b3),
        ]
        b3 = torch.cat(b3, 1)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(feats, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [br1, b2, b3, bp]

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(feats)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class MLP(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super(EncoderLayer, self).__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, inp):
        torch._assert(inp.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {inp.shape}")
        h, _ = self.self_attention(inp, inp, inp, need_weights=False)
        h = self.ln_1(self.dropout(h) + inp)
        y = self.mlp(h)
        return self.ln_2(h + y)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def make_conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def make_conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, shortcut: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super(Bottleneck, self).__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.c1 = make_conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.c2 = make_conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.c3 = make_conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.relu3 = nn.ReLU()
        self.shortcut = shortcut
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        residual = input

        y = self.c1(input)
        y = self.bn1(y)
        y = self.relu1(y)
        y = self.c2(y)
        y = self.bn2(y)
        y = self.relu2(y)
        y = self.c3(y)
        y = self.bn3(y)

        if self.shortcut is not None:
            residual = self.shortcut(input)

        y += residual
        y = self.relu3(y)
        return y

class MLP(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),

class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert hidden_dim % num_heads == 0, "hidden_dim must be divisible by num_heads"
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, input):
        h = self.ln_1(input)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + input

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv_bn_act(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
    layers = [
        nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding,
                  groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU6())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class MixedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = conv_bn_act(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = conv_bn_act(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2a = conv_bn_act(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch2_2b = conv_bn_act(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch3_1 = conv_bn_act(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = conv_bn_act(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(7, 1))
        self.branch3_3 = conv_bn_act(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 7))
        self.branch_pool = conv_bn_act(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, feats: Tensor):
        y1 = self.branch1(feats)
        br2 = self.branch2_1(feats)
        br2 = [
            self.branch2_2a(br2),
            self.branch2_2b(br2),
        ]
        br2 = torch.cat(br2, 1)
        br3 = self.branch3_1(feats)
        br3 = self.branch3_2(br3)
        br3 = self.branch3_3(br3)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(feats, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [y1, br2, br3, bp]

    def forward(self, feats: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        outputs = self._forward(feats)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


def shuffle_channels(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = tensor.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(tensor), self.branch2(tensor)), dim=1)
        out = shuffle_channels(out, 2)
        return out

import torch

def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip: Optional[nn.Module] = None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn_a = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.bn_b = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        identity = z

        out = self.c1(z)
        out = self.bn_a(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.c2(out)
        out = self.bn_b(out)

        if self.skip is not None:
            identity = self.skip(z)

        out += identity
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x


class ShuffleResidual(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super(ShuffleResidual, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(inp),
                nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1,
                      groups=branch_features, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, inp):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = inp.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(inp), self.branch2(inp)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out


class ShuffleBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(ShuffleBackbone, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, 2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(16), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        input_channels = 16
        seq = [ShuffleResidual(input_channels, 32, 2)]
        for _ in range(0):
            seq.append(ShuffleResidual(32, 32, 1))
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*seq)
        input_channels = 32
        seq = [ShuffleResidual(input_channels, 64, 2)]
        for _ in range(2):
            seq.append(ShuffleResidual(64, 64, 1))

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(DenseLayer, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu1 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu1(self.norm1(z)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu2(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(_DenseBlock, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        features = [z]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)


class DenseBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(DenseBackbone, self).__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = _DenseBlock(3, 16, 4, 12)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(52), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(52, 26, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = _DenseBlock(2, 26, 4, 12)
        self.transition2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(50), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(50, 25, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock3 = _DenseBlock(4, 25, 4, 12)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(73)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(73, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(z)))
        z = self.denseblock1(z)
        z = self.transition1(z)
        z = self.denseblock2(z)
        z = self.transition2(z)
        z = self.denseblock3(z)
        z = F.relu(self.norm_final(z))
        z = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(z, (1, 1))
        z = torch.flatten(z, 1)
        return self.classifier(z)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(F.relu6(self.norm1(x), inplace=True))
        out = self.conv2(F.relu6(self.norm2(out), inplace=True))
        return out


class DenseStage(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        features = [x]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)


class DenseNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = DenseStage(2, 24, 4, 12)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = DenseStage(3, 24, 4, 12)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(60)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(60, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        x = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(x)))
        x = self.denseblock1(x)
        x = self.transition1(x)
        x = self.denseblock2(x)
        x = F.relu(self.norm_final(x))
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, (1, 1))
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        return self.classifier(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class DenseUnit(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(DenseUnit, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.SiLU()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, z):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(z)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class DenseStage(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(DenseStage, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, z):
        outputs = [z]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(outputs, 1))
            outputs.append(new)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)


class DenseNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super(DenseNetLike, self).__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = DenseStage(4, 16, 2, 8)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = DenseStage(3, 24, 2, 8)
        self.transition2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock3 = DenseStage(3, 24, 2, 8)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(48)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(48, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(z)))
        z = self.denseblock1(z)
        z = self.transition1(z)
        z = self.denseblock2(z)
        z = self.transition2(z)
        z = self.denseblock3(z)
        z = F.relu(self.norm_final(z))
        z = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(z, (1, 1))
        z = torch.flatten(z, 1)
        return self.classifier(z)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1,
                     groups=groups, bias=False)


def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)


class ResUnit(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip: Optional[nn.Module] = None, norm_layer: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super(ResUnit, self).__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv1 = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv2 = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.bn2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        identity = tensor

        h = self.conv1(tensor)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = self.relu(h)
        h = self.conv2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)

        if self.skip is not None:
            identity = self.skip(tensor)

        h = h + identity
        h = self.relu(h)
        return h


class ResidualNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, block, num_classes=10):
        super(ResidualNet, self).__init__()
        self.inplanes = 24
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, self.inplanes, kernel_size=5, stride=2, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(self.inplanes)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.maxpool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.layer1 = self._make_layer(block, 24, 2)
        self.layer2 = self._make_layer(block, 48, 1, stride=2)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(48 * block.expansion, num_classes)

    def _make_layer(self, block, planes, blocks, stride=1):
        downsample = None
        if stride != 1 or self.inplanes != planes * block.expansion:
            downsample = nn.Sequential(
                conv1x1(self.inplanes, planes * block.expansion, stride),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * block.expansion),
            )
        layers = [block(self.inplanes, planes, stride, downsample)]
        self.inplanes = planes * block.expansion
        for _ in range(1, blocks):
            layers.append(block(self.inplanes, planes))
        return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        tensor = self.conv1(tensor)
        tensor = self.bn1(tensor)
        tensor = self.relu(tensor)
        tensor = self.maxpool(tensor)
        tensor = self.layer1(tensor)
        tensor = self.layer2(tensor)
        tensor = self.avgpool(tensor)
        tensor = torch.flatten(tensor, 1)
        tensor = self.fc(tensor)
        return tensor

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super(ConvBN, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.relu6(z)


class InceptionA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super(InceptionA, self).__init__()
        self.branch1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2 = ConvBN(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 7), padding=(0, 3))
        self.branch2_3 = ConvBN(ch2 * 2, ch2, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.branch3_1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch3_2 = ConvBN(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = ConvBN(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, z):
        b1 = self.branch1(z)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(z)
        y2 = self.branch2_2(y2)
        y2 = self.branch2_3(y2)
        y3 = self.branch3_1(z)
        y3 = self.branch3_2(y3)
        bp = self.pool(z)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [b1, y2, y3, bp]

    def forward(self, z):
        outputs = self._forward(z)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)


class MiniInception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super(MiniInception, self).__init__()
        self.stem1 = ConvBN(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stem2 = ConvBN(24, 24, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.mixed_1 = InceptionA(24, 12, 12, 8, 16)
        self.mixed_2 = InceptionA(56, 24, 12, 8, 16)
        self.mixed_3 = InceptionA(68, 8, 24, 16, 8)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.2)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(72, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.stem1(z)
        z = self.stem2(z)
        z = F.max_pool2d(z, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        z = self.mixed_1(z)
        z = self.mixed_2(z)
        z = self.mixed_3(z)
        z = self.avgpool(z)
        z = torch.flatten(z, 1)
        z = self.dropout(z)
        z = self.fc(z)
        return z

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Fire(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super(Fire, self).__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.act(self.squeeze(feats))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.act(self.expand1x1(feats)), self.act(self.expand3x3(feats))], 1
        )


class SqueezeNetLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super(SqueezeNetLike, self).__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(32, 8, 32, 32),
            Fire(64, 8, 32, 32),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            Fire(64, 16, 64, 64),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(128, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.features(feats)
        feats = self.classifier(feats)
        return torch.flatten(feats, 1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class MLP(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class TransformerLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, inp):
        h = self.ln_1(inp)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + inp

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 64, 16))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            TransformerLayer(4, 16, 32),
            TransformerLayer(4, 16, 32),
            TransformerLayer(4, 16, 32),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(16, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(16, num_classes)

    def forward(self, inp):
        n, c, h, w = inp.shape
        torch._assert(h == 32, f"Wrong image height! Expected 32 but got {h}!")
        torch._assert(w == 32, f"Wrong image width! Expected 32 but got {w}!")
        x = self.conv_proj(inp)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        return self.head(x)

    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super(EncoderLayer, self).__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads

        self.mlp = MLP(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.ln_1(x)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + x

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super(BasicConv2d, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.relu(z)


class Inception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features):
        super(Inception, self).__init__()
        self.branch1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_1 = BasicConv2d(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch2_2a = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch2_2b = BasicConv2d(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = BasicConv2d(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        b1 = self.branch1(z)
        y2 = self.branch2_1(z)
        y2 = [
            self.branch2_2a(y2),
            self.branch2_2b(y2),
        ]
        y2 = torch.cat(y2, 1)
        bp = self.pool(z)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([b1, y2, bp], dim=1)


class MiniInception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super(MiniInception, self).__init__()
        self.stem1 = BasicConv2d(3, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stem2 = BasicConv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.mixed_1 = Inception(16, 12, 12, 16)
        self.mixed_2 = Inception(76, 24, 16, 8)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.2)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(96, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        z = self.stem1(z)
        z = self.stem2(z)
        z = F.max_pool2d(z, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        z = self.mixed_1(z)
        z = self.mixed_2(z)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class DenseLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(DenseLayer, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(inp)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out


class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(_DenseBlock, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        feats_list = [inp]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)


class DenseBackbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(DenseBackbone, self).__init__()
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm0 = nn.BatchNorm2d(24)
        self.relu0 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.denseblock1 = _DenseBlock(3, 24, 2, 8)
        self.transition1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm2d(48), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(48, 24, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2))
        self.denseblock2 = _DenseBlock(3, 24, 2, 8)
        self.norm_final = nn.BatchNorm2d(48)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(48, num_classes)

    def forward(self, inp: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        inp = self.relu0(self.norm0(self.conv0(inp)))
        inp = self.denseblock1(inp)
        inp = self.transition1(inp)
        inp = self.denseblock2(inp)
        inp = F.relu(self.norm_final(inp))
        inp = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(inp, (1, 1))
        inp = torch.flatten(inp, 1)
        return self.classifier(inp)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SqueezeExpand(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.ReLU6()
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.ReLU6()
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.ReLU6()

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.squeeze_activation(self.sq(feats))
        return torch.cat(
            [self.expand1x1_activation(self.ex1(feats)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.ex3(feats))], 1
        )


class FireNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(64, 8, 32, 32),
            SqueezeExpand(64, 8, 32, 32),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(64, 16, 64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True),
            SqueezeExpand(128, 16, 64, 64),
        )
        final_conv = nn.Conv2d(128, num_classes, kernel_size=1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5), final_conv, nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        )

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.features(feats)
        feats = self.classifier(feats)
        return torch.flatten(feats, 1)

def conv_bn_relu(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size)
    layers = [
        nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding,
                  groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
    ]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, tensor):
        scale = self.avgpool(tensor)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * tensor


class MBConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(conv_bn_relu(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(conv_bn_relu(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SELayer(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        out = self.conv(tensor)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + tensor
        return out


class MBNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        input_channel = 32
        settings = [
            [1, 16, 1, 1, False],
            [3, 24, 2, 2, False],
            [6, 32, 3, 2, True],
            [4, 64, 2, 2, False],
            [6, 64, 3, 2, False],
        ]
        features = [conv_bn_relu(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(MBConv(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(conv_bn_relu(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tensor):
        tensor = self.features(tensor)
        tensor = tensor.mean([2, 3])
        tensor = self.classifier(tensor)
        return tensor

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        h = self.ln_1(tensor)
        h, _ = self.self_attention(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = h + tensor

        y = self.ln_2(h)
        y = self.mlp(y)
        return h + y


class TinyViT(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 64, 32))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            EncoderBlock(2, 32, 64),
            EncoderBlock(2, 32, 64),
            EncoderBlock(2, 32, 64),
            EncoderBlock(2, 32, 64),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(32, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(32, num_classes)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        n, c, h, w = tensor.shape
        torch._assert(h == 32, f"Wrong image height! Expected 32 but got {h}!")
        torch._assert(w == 32, f"Wrong image width! Expected 32 but got {w}!")
        x = self.conv_proj(tensor)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        return self.head(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ConvBN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super(ConvBN, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.relu6(z)


class MixedBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features):
        super(MixedBlock, self).__init__()
        self.branch_a = ConvBN(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = ConvBN(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_b_3a = ConvBN(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch_b_3b = ConvBN(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1), padding=(1, 0))
        self.branch_c_1 = ConvBN(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2 = ConvBN(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch_pool = ConvBN(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, z):
        y1 = self.branch_a(z)
        y2 = self.branch_b_1(z)
        y2 = self.branch_b_2(y2)
        y2 = [
            self.branch_b_3a(y2),
            self.branch_b_3b(y2),
        ]
        y2 = torch.cat(y2, 1)
        y3 = self.branch_c_1(z)
        y3 = self.branch_c_2(y3)
        bp = F.avg_pool2d(z, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([y1, y2, y3, bp], dim=1)


class MiniInception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super(MiniInception, self).__init__()
        self.stem1 = ConvBN(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stem2 = ConvBN(24, 24, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.mixed_1 = MixedBlock(24, 16, 8, 12, 8)
        self.mixed_2 = MixedBlock(52, 12, 16, 24, 8)
        self.mixed_3 = MixedBlock(76, 12, 16, 8, 8)
        self.mixed_4 = MixedBlock(60, 24, 8, 8, 8)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.2)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(56, num_classes)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.stem1(z)
        z = self.stem2(z)
        z = self.mixed_1(z)
        z = self.mixed_2(z)
        z = self.mixed_3(z)
        z = self.mixed_4(z)
        z = self.avgpool(z)
        z = torch.flatten(z, 1)
        z = self.dropout(z)
        z = self.fc(z)
        return z

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        tensor = self.conv(tensor)
        tensor = self.bn(tensor)
        return F.relu(tensor, inplace=True)


class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, tensor):
        scale = self.avgpool(tensor)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * tensor


class MBConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup

        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(nn.BatchNorm2d(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        if self.use_residual:
            return tensor + self.conv(tensor)
        return self.conv(tensor)


class EfficientLike(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super().__init__()
        input_channel = 24
        settings = [
            [1, 12, 1, 1, False],
            [3, 24, 3, 1, False],
            [4, 48, 2, 1, False],
            [3, 96, 1, 2, False],
            [6, 96, 1, 1, True],
        ]
        features = [BasicConv2d(3, input_channel, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)]
        for t, c, n, s, se in settings:
            for i in range(n):
                stride = s if i == 0 else 1
                features.append(MBConv(input_channel, c, stride, expand_ratio=t, use_se=se))
                input_channel = c
        features.append(BasicConv2d(input_channel, 128, kernel_size=1))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*features)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class MLPBlock(nn.Sequential):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, mlp_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, mlp_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(mlp_dim, in_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )


class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):
        super().__init__()

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.mlp = MLPBlock(hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 3, f"Expected (batch_size, seq_length, hidden_dim) got {x.shape}")
        h, _ = self.self_attention(x, x, x, need_weights=False)
        h = self.ln_1(self.dropout(h) + x)
        y = self.mlp(h)
        return self.ln_2(h + y)


class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=100):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_proj = nn.Conv2d(3, 48, kernel_size=4, stride=4)
        self.class_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, 48))
        self.pos_embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 17, 48))
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            EncoderBlock(4, 48, 96),
            EncoderBlock(4, 48, 96),
        )
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(48, eps=1e-6)
        self.head = nn.Linear(48, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        n, c, h, w = x.shape
        torch._assert(h == 16, f"Wrong image height! Expected 16 but got {h}!")
        torch._assert(w == 16, f"Wrong image width! Expected 16 but got {w}!")
        x = self.conv_proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        batch_class_token = self.class_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([batch_class_token, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embedding
        x = self.encoder(x)
        x = self.ln(x)
        x = x[:, 0]
        return self.head(x)

    def __init__(self, num_heads, hidden_dim, mlp_dim, dropout=0.0):

from typing import Callable, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor


class ConvLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        tensor = self.conv(tensor)
        tensor = self.bn(tensor)
        return self.act(tensor)


class MultiBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features, conv_block: Optional[Callable[..., nn.Module]] = None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvLayer
        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_b_3 = conv_block(ch2 * 2, ch2 * 2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        br1 = self.branch_a(tensor)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(tensor)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        b2 = self.branch_b_3(b2)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(tensor, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return torch.cat([br1, b2, bp], dim=1)


class MultiBranchNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem1 = ConvLayer(3, 24, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.stem2 = ConvLayer(24, 24, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.mixed_1 = MultiBranch(24, 8, 24, 16)
        self.mixed_2 = MultiBranch(72, 16, 12, 8)
        self.mixed_3 = MultiBranch(48, 24, 24, 16)
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.2)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(88, num_classes)

    def forward(self, tensor: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        tensor = self.stem1(tensor)
        tensor = self.stem2(tensor)
        tensor = F.max_pool2d(tensor, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        tensor = self.mixed_1(tensor)
        tensor = self.mixed_2(tensor)
        tensor = F.max_pool2d(tensor, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        tensor = self.mixed_3(tensor)
        tensor = self.avgpool(tensor)
        tensor = torch.flatten(tensor, 1)
        tensor = self.dropout(tensor)
        tensor = self.fc(tensor)
        return tensor
